caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical cabinet or mantle clock with three main sections, set against a plain beige background. The entire structure is primarily black with gold detailing. The center section, which is the tallest, features a rectangular clock face at the top, the numbers and markings in black; beneath the clock face is a yellowish-gold lyre motif surrounded by floral decorations. The left and right sections are identical in height and width, each with a large rectangular panel adorned with ornate golden patterns resembling floral or sunburst designs, framed in gold filigree. Four decorative columns, two on each side of the center section, have gold accents and stylized floral patterns, with bases and capitals. The top edge of each section is flat, with the central panel projecting higher than the two flanking panels. Additional gold inlay, including symmetrical patterns and borders, embellishes all three sections and the tops of the columns, providing an ornate and detailed appearance.
title: Clock - Lyre Type
